season_level.definition: every pair of teams meets exactly twice (once home, once away)
season_level.expected_schedule_rule: 2018 official: 23 clubs x 34 games; each club faces each conference opponent twice (1H/1A) plus 2 extra intra-conference games (East) / 1 extra (West); each non-conference opponent once. Observed: 132 cross-conference pairs met exactly once; 104 intra-conference pairs met twice; 17 met three times (extra games). Not double round robin.

row_level_rows_2018.field_locator: Scores & Fixtures table, Regular Season rows (chronological)
row_level_rows_2018.derivation_rule: unordered pair {home,away}; order all season meetings by date; meeting_number = ordinal (1-based)
row_level_rows_2018.evidence_notes: pair meets 2x in 2018 regular season; row 1 of 2

row_level_rows_2018.field_locator: Scores & Fixtures table, Regular Season rows (chronological)
row_level_rows_2018.derivation_rule: true iff meeting_number==2 (second meeting of the pair in the season)
row_level_rows_2018.evidence_notes: official 2018 format: conference opponents twice (1H/1A) + extra intra-conference games; non-conference once — see season record

row_level_rows_2018.field_locator: Scores & Fixtures table, Regular Season rows (chronological)
row_level_rows_2018.derivation_rule: for meeting_number==2: true iff home/away swapped vs first meeting (first.home==second.away and first.away==second.home)
